Sources: Omaxe's Lucknow web pages, Omaxe stock-exchange disclosures and results as reported by financial news sites, UP RERA project records (via Aurum PropTech's RERA mirror), NBM&CW, ThePrint/Bhasha and listings where marked. Independent guide by DSD Properties — we are not affiliated with Omaxe. Updated: 19 October 2026.

Key Facts (updated 19 October 2026)

  • Omaxe Ltd is a New Delhi-based, stock-market-listed developer founded by Rohtas Goel; it began as a construction business in 1987 and entered real estate in 2001 (Wikipedia (archived copy)).
  • In Lucknow it lists 17 residential and 4 commercial projects, including Omaxe City (140 acres, delivered) and the 690-acre Omaxe Metro City on Raebareli Road (Omaxe Lucknow page, Omaxe City page, NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026).
  • Its newest Lucknow project, Omaxe Cassia (8 towers, 360 flats), had about 300 flats sold by April 2026; RERA completion date 8 April 2029 (NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026, RERA record).
  • Omaxe Ltd reported a ₹696.80 crore net loss in FY 2025-26 on revenue of ₹1,253.40 crore, then a small ₹1.30 crore consolidated profit in April–June 2026 (FY26 results report, Q1 FY27 results report, 12 Aug 2026).
  • Its new Lucknow projects are registered on RERA by a subsidiary, Omaxe Garv Buildtech Pvt Ltd — make sure your agreement names it.

You will see the Omaxe name across Lucknow — on Raebareli Road townships, Gomti Nagar Extension apartments and the Omaxe Hazratganj commercial complex. This guide explains, in plain words, who Omaxe is, what it has built and is building in Lucknow, how the company is doing financially, and what to check before you buy. Every fact has a source link; where we rely on a listing, we say so.

What this means for you

Omaxe is a large, listed company, so its results are public every quarter. But each Lucknow project is registered on RERA by a specific company — for new projects like Cassia and The Nest that is a subsidiary, Omaxe Garv Buildtech. Your agreement must be with the company on your project's RERA record.

Omaxe Cassia — the newest launch

In April 2026, Omaxe told the stock exchanges it would invest about ₹250 crore in Omaxe Cassia, a project of 8 towers with 2 and 3 BHK flats inside Omaxe Metro City on Raebareli Road. About 300 of its 360 units were already sold, and it expected to finish in about three years (NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026, ThePrint Hindi / Bhasha, 29 Apr 2026). The project is registered in two phases:

What this means for buyers

Omaxe made large losses in the last two financial years and returned to a small profit in the April–June 2026 quarter. Losses at company level do not mean a project will stop — under RERA, 70% of buyers' money for a project must be kept in that project's own bank account. But it makes it more important to buy where construction is visibly moving: read the quarterly progress report on up-rera.in, visit the site, and prefer paying in step with construction.

Outside Uttar Pradesh, the Punjab RERA has ordered Omaxe to refund buyers or pay delay interest in some of its Punjab projects (LiveLaw). We did not find a comparable UP RERA order for its Lucknow projects in our search, but you should check the complaint history of your project on up-rera.in before booking.

Buying from Omaxe in Lucknow? Check these first

  1. RERA number of your exact phase and tower — search it on up-rera.in and note the promoter (often Omaxe Garv Buildtech for new projects).
  2. Construction progress — compare the RERA quarterly report with what you see on site before every big payment.
  3. Carpet area — your agreement must state the RERA carpet area; compare prices per sq ft of carpet area.
  4. Complaints — check the project's complaint history on up-rera.in.
  5. Older Omaxe colonies and resale — ask for the seller's registered sale deed, the original conveyance from Omaxe, maintenance dues clearance and an encumbrance certificate; check past registries on IGRSUP.
  6. Plots in Omaxe City or Metro City — confirm the plot on the approved layout and the township's building rules.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Who owns Omaxe?

Omaxe Limited was founded by Rohtas Goel, who started it as a construction and contracting business in 1987; it was incorporated in 1989 as Omaxe Builders Pvt Ltd and listed on the stock market in 2007 (Wikipedia (archived copy)). Mohit Goel is its Managing Director (NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026).

What are Omaxe's projects in Lucknow?

Omaxe lists 17 residential and 4 commercial projects in Lucknow (Omaxe Lucknow page). The best known are Omaxe City (140 acres of plots and villas, delivered) and the 690-acre Omaxe Metro City township on Raebareli Road, where Omaxe Cassia is now being built (Omaxe City page, NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026).

Is Omaxe financially stable?

Omaxe Ltd reported consolidated net losses of ₹685.40 crore in FY 2024-25 and ₹696.80 crore in FY 2025-26 (FY26 results report). In April–June 2026 it reported a small consolidated profit of ₹1.30 crore, while the parent company on its own still made a loss (Q1 FY27 results report, 12 Aug 2026). Buyers should judge each project by its RERA progress and construction on site.

When will Omaxe Cassia be completed?

Both Cassia phases are registered with UP RERA until 8 April 2029 (RERA record, RERA record). In April 2026 Omaxe said it expected to complete the project in about three years (NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026).

Who is the RERA promoter of Omaxe Cassia?

Omaxe Garv Buildtech Private Limited (formerly Garv Buildtech Private Limited), a wholly owned subsidiary of Omaxe Ltd (RERA record, NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026). Your agreement should name this company.

Where is Omaxe Metro City?

On Raebareli Road, Lucknow; Omaxe describes it as a 690-acre township (NBM&CW, 30 Apr 2026). RERA lists its Cassia phases in Sarojini Nagar tehsil (RERA record).
